Exercise: BODYWEIGHT RUSSIAN TWIST, rotated position. Seated on buttocks, knees bent in front, both HEELS grounded lightly shoulder-width. Torso leans back roughly35degrees from vertical, spine neutral and chest open. Turn ribcage and shoulders moderately to subject's RIGHT while pelvis and knees remain facing forward; both hands clasped together in front of right lower ribs, clearly to one side of knees. Arms bent softly and move with torso. No dumbbell or medicine ball. FRONT three-quarter slightly elevated view makes moderate trunk rotation and static legs legible, no extreme spinal twist. Highlight exposed rectus abdominis and OBLIQUES ONLY. Whole figure and floor contacts inside square.

review.notes: Seated with bent knees and grounded heels; hands clasped beside torso, ribcage rotated moderately relative to forward-facing thighs. Torso leans back modestly, with abdominal and oblique overlay. Static still does not establish alternating rotation.
review.independentNotes: Independent visual review: bent knees and grounded heels support a slightly reclined, rotated torso; clasped hands held beside the hip. Coral is confined to the visible core.
